domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Follow-up owed by PR #27620 (#27514), its `Skills-docs:` line.

## What is missing

`content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` documents the `GET /api/v1/meta/diagnostics` query parameters. After PR #27620 the route refuses an unknown `type`, an unknown `severity` (anything but `error` / `warning`) and an unknown `package` with 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` in the nested `{ error: { code, message } }` envelope, and `stats` is keyed by the canonical type (an alias such as a plural reads under its canonical key). The page states none of this. Nothing on it becomes false; it is incomplete.

Re-check: `grep -n "diagnostics" content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` and the route in `packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts` once #27620 is merged.

## Expected

The query table names the three refusals and the canonical `stats` key. Docs only; filed without `domain:*` (`content/docs/**` is triage's call).
